messages.subject: Re: Stage36 complete cohort: gate arithmetic review requested
messages.body:
Stage36 guarded cohort: gate-by-gate independent verification complete. Every number in your summary reproduces exactly, every frozen condition holds, and engineering_accepted true is supported. Source-only, read-only, no edits, no builds, no tests, no load.

GOVERNING TEXT. One copy only for this cohort: PROMOTION_RULE.md, 2212 bytes, sha256 650c9ead66d9d87969b2ed3a5cfe2167aa737525e2ec6c76c85de8f845a1c2b5, matching its pin. No acceptance/acceptance-v2 split to disambiguate this time. SCENARIO_LIMIT.md is present and recorded before timing; it carries both follow-up notes I raised on 7812838 (Nuxt auto-import body edits change the full-source composition signature and are not claimed; named addImports registrations stay unmodelled on cold and delta). So the archive states the benefit limit itself, not just the benefit.

SUMMARIZER PROVENANCE. summarize-timing.py matches its pin and differs from the Stage35-accepted copy only in the primary-scenario selection and its threshold: primary comparison noop to body, gain test -2 percent to -5 percent, and the reported primary_scenario label. Everything else is the same code, including the fail-closed recomputation of require_memory_evidence and require_power_evidence against the recorded fields, the window and order enforcement, the receipt-eligibility checks and the cross-arm graph identity check. memory_gate.py, power_gate.py, pressure_monitor.py, timing_gate.py, background_gate.py and run-timing-series.py are byte-identical to the Stage35-accepted copies, verified by diff, and all match their pins. So the stricter primary bar was substituted without touching any host, power, window or correctness machinery.

PRIMARY GATE, body, fresh-process.
Medians 4.1411249166 to 3.7772630000 s, ratio of medians 0.9121345229, -8.786548 percent against the -5 percent bar: PASS with 3.79 pp of headroom and 0.363862 s absolute.
All six paired percent changes negative: PASS at -8.544861, -9.216889, -9.159434, -9.499442, -7.316225, -13.108730. Worst pair is 7.32 pp inside the below-one line, not the millisecond margins of the Stage35 noop cohort.
Ranges are disjoint: baseline 4.075867 to 4.450646 against candidate 3.727590 to 3.867223. ranges_overlap is False for body and True for the other three, which is consistent.
Robustness, reported as description not as a rule variant: drop-one jackknife gives -8.41 to -9.16 percent, every one of the twenty 3-pair subsets gives -7.32 to -9.50 percent, and median-of-paired-ratios (not the gate definition) gives -9.188 percent. The decision does not depend on any single pair or on the ratio-of-medians choice.

NON-PRIMARY TIME GATE, at most 2 percent median regression: PASS at initial -0.441914, noop -0.107044, structural -0.025891 percent. None is a regression at all. Their paired values straddle zero in both directions, which is the coherence check I care about: the effect is confined to the one scenario the mechanism predicts and does not leak.

RSS GATE, at most 5 percent median increase per scenario: PASS at initial -1.9495, noop -0.2376, body +0.7789, structural -4.3034 percent. Body is the only increase and it is far inside the line.

AGGREGATE GATES. Sum of scenario medians 21.718861312547 to 21.301778041583 s, -0.417083270964 s, -1.9204 percent: nonincreasing, PASS. Mean scenario median ratio 0.9765965050876149 below 1: PASS. Both reproduce to the last digit; I compared by repr, not by rounding. timing-comparison.json and summary-output.json are byte-identical.

MECHANISM RECEIPT, which is what makes the body result readable rather than merely favorable. In all six pairs body parses go 21 to 1, files_read 21 to 1, summary_scans 127 to 0, derived_indexes 16 to 1, cached_files 6783 to 6803, and ParsedByReason goes from resolution 20 plus source content 1 to source content 1 alone. Both arms publish owner_scope_count 0, zero node and edge deltas, two messages, generation 1 to 2, and the same graph hash as initial. The frozen-scope fallback string is character-identical in both arms, so nothing was narrowed. The suppressed work was provably output-neutral in this scenario.

CORRECTNESS, recomputed rather than read off flags. Exactly one distinct graph hash per label across all twelve arms: 7fe9440b1d16a8d3 for initial, noop, body, cold-original and cold-body, and 5dec281283083790 for structural and cold-structural, with wire.normalized_hash equal to graph_hash wherever published. Incremental equals cold in every arm for initial, body and structural: zero mismatches in 36 comparisons. Noop invariants hold in all twelve arms: zero parsed, zero read, zero wire messages, BaseGeneration equal to TargetGeneration, state_before equal to state_after. Broker completeness_status success and batch_count_matches_end true on every published label in every arm; noop correctly has neither. 48 of 48 explicit checks pass, all twelve arms exit 0 with error null, all_checks_validated true, timing_eligible true, correctness_only false, no host or background sample errors.
No refill and no sample reuse. cli-pairs holds exactly twelve timing arms; the extra correctness-candidate-1 directory is labelled correctness_only true and timing_eligible false, and the top-level baseline-correctness-acceptance.json points at the Stage35 tree receipt with the note "correctness evidence only; no timing samples reused". final-candidate-acceptance.json records source 7812838, test 3a94865, binary f69bae09, and all three evidence paths hash-match.

PINS AND PROVENANCE. All 110 pinned files present and hash-matching, all three binaries matching. Per-arm provenance is identical across arms except binary path, binary sha256, started_ns and the per-arm product repo path; observer, observer sha256, original_file_sha256, product_sha 01baa6eb0cc2ea74018eafc07e230a29d4efa8f4 and profile full are common. argv is identical across all twelve arms except the arm token and the repeat number. runtime_environment records ENOLA_GRAPH_PROFILE null, so no scratch profiling instrumentation was active, and nats_max_payload 8388608.

WINDOW, ORDER AND COORDINATION. Realized order is BCCBBCCBBCCB, that is AB, BA, AB, BA, AB, BA: three of each, no re-selection, no pooling. Arms are contiguous, each start_utc equal to the previous end_utc, spanning 15:50:00.067441 to 16:05:36.932022 UTC, entirely inside the acknowledged 15:50 to 16:55 interval, using 15.6 of 65 minutes. Positional balance is exact: baseline occupies 1, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12 and candidate 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, both summing to 39, so any monotonic host drift across the cohort cancels.
I re-validated the four-participant roster per participant rather than trusting the aggregate: each evidence file hashes to its recorded value, each held message id and from_handle match that participant's own entry, created_at times are same-day 15:40:57Z, 15:41:46Z and 15:42:27Z, the 15:50 and 16:55 strings appear in each body, and the terminal-held quote is present in the terminal tail observed 15:44:24Z. Four distinct handles. To be explicit again: pair-receipt.json records one quiet_ack_message_id, msg_91c959ad9f93, which is mine and stands only for my own terminal. It is not the window authorization and must never be archived as evidence that any other participant was notified. I have no channel to the other participants and asked nobody to hold.

HOST CONDITIONS. Pressure: 3567 samples, every one Darwin dispatch level 1, zero errors, maximum gap 0.2752 s against the 1.0 s rejection threshold, and the monotonic interval covered in all twelve arms. Each arm's recorded memory_evidence recomputes from the raw files. Swapouts constant at 3042366 across all 24 observations, so zero new Swapouts. Swapins rise by 1808 in total, monotonically, with no counter reset; largest single arm is baseline-5 at +568. Reported as context only, with no bounded-latency or attribution claim. Whole-host audit is 30 to 32 samples per arm with no sample errors. caffeinate appears in every host sample of every arm; the -i flag itself remains unverifiable because the sampler omits process arguments, so what is established is that caffeinate ran throughout and that no suspension occurred.

SUSPENSION DETECTOR, with a correction to how I would previously have read it. Series-level wall-minus-monotonic drift here is 2148.72 to 2274.33 ms per arm, which is not comparable to the at-most-4.9 ms figure I reported for Stage35: that was the finer per-sample measure. Recomputing Stage35 with this cohort's exact formula gives 2143 to 2330 ms, mean 2184 ms, so the two cohorts agree, and run-timing-series.py explains the gap: start_utc is taken before docker stats, vm_stat and the power capture and end_utc after the second vm_stat and power capture, while monotonic_start and monotonic_end bracket only the measured subprocess. The fine-grained detector for this cohort is the per-pressure-sample wall-minus-monotonic offset, whose total spread is 3.91 ms across all 3567 samples. No suspension anywhere. I flag this because I nearly reported the 2.2 s as a host anomaly; it is an instrumentation constant, and the earlier 4.9 ms number should not be quoted as a series-level threshold.

POWER. AC power at all 24 boundary observations, lowpowermode 0 in every AC profile, and all twelve arms bracketed by their own observations. Charge is 75 to 83 percent, every observation above the 20 percent floor. One plain record observation with no inference attached: charge declines monotonically 83 to 75 percent across the cohort while pmset reports AC and charging. I am not reviving any throttling hypothesis from that, per your correction; I note only that the exact positional balance above cancels any monotonic host trend, whatever its cause. Boundary observations do not prove uninterrupted AC within an arm, consistent with the rule text and power_gate's own coverage annotation.

HISTORICAL AND FULL-REPOSITORY CHECKS. history-recent and history-broad-v2 both record accepted true with problems empty and completed_sequence true; all 8 series gates pass (candidate and baseline binary pins, policy, observer, nats, source-head, commit-chain, chain-initial-fresh), and both steps in each history pass all 10 per-step gates including delta-equals-cold, noop-zero-parses, noop-stable-generation, noop-zero-events, noop-state-unchanged and baseline-cold-equals-candidate-cold, with baseline_cold_hash equal to candidate_cold_hash equal to effective_hash. That satisfies the frozen condition. Coverage is two commits per history, four in total, so complete current-main historical coverage remains an open obligation rather than something this cohort closes.

FINDINGS TO RECORD IN THE ARCHIVE. None of these is a gate failure and none of them changes the decision.

1. Pair 6 is the contaminated pair, and the contamination direction favors the candidate. Summed foreign CPU means are 231.01 percent in baseline-6 and 195.31 percent in candidate-6, against 85.71 to 109.47 percent everywhere else; the two heavy foreign processes are siriactionsd at roughly 82 to 91 percent and BackgroundShortcutRunner at roughly 38 to 45 percent. Both arms of pair 6 are the cohort's slowest, and pair 6 is also the largest win at -13.108730 percent. Cohort-wide the same imbalance is present but small: baseline arms average 119.69 percent foreign CPU against candidate 111.71 percent, a 7.98 pp difference nominally favoring the candidate. This is exactly why the jackknife matters and why I ran it: excluding pair 6 still gives -8.41 percent, so the gate does not rest on the contaminated pair. Reported as honest contention, not as a clean host.

2. The run-identifier naming artifact reproduces exactly as in Stage35. run_id is 58 characters for baseline and 59 for candidate, giving payload_bytes_total +3092 on initial, cold-original, cold-body and cold-structural (3091 messages plus one, because begin carries the identifier twice) and +4 on structural (3 messages plus one), with begin +2 and end +1. Harness naming, not candidate behavior.

3. Body is the one genuine publication-content difference, and it accounts to the byte with nothing left over. payload_bytes_total 1029 to 1013, that is -16, decomposing as begin +2 and end -18. The end -18 is the dropped ParsedByReason entry for resolution 20, which is 16 characters including its comma, plus -1 for completeness_parsed_files 21 to 1, plus -2 for completeness_summary_scans 127 to 0, plus +1 for the longer run identifier; cached_files 6783 to 6803 is digit-neutral. Sum -16 -1 -2 +1 equals -18 exactly. Graph content, message count, owner scopes, ContextAffectedSources, ContextReasons, OwnersPublished, EarlyLocal, the frozen-scope fallback string, schema_version and scope_mode are all identical. So the smaller End record is the completeness report truthfully describing less work, not a change in publication semantics.

4. summary_scans and derived_indexes remain nondeterministic in the initial scenario with heavily overlapping ranges; medians move 2269.5 to 2280.0 and 4459.5 to 4449.0. Context only. I did not normalize these fields away.

5. state_final_bytes varies run to run within the same binary, 90686159 to 90686594 across the cohort. So unchanged checkpoint bytes is satisfiable only as the within-noop before-and-after invariant, which holds in all twelve arms, and can never be read as cross-arm byte identity.

TWO ARCHIVE-HYGIENE ITEMS, your call, no rerun requested.
a. pins.json still carries purpose "Stage36 guarded candidate correctness; no acceptance timing yet", which is stale now that the acceptance series has run. Same item I raised for Stage35.
b. full-suite-receipt.json records go test ./... with exit 0, 110 passing packages and 104 explicitly served from cache, with no elapsed time and no start or end timestamps. It therefore attests no failures under the current cache state, which is weaker than a fresh full execution; the Stage35 receipt at least recorded 150.745 s. Worth one archive line so the strength of the attestation is not overstated later.

SCOPE LIMITS, restated from the rule's own closing paragraph so publication does not overreach. Five percent on one scenario is a limited engineering target, not completion of the substantially-faster-delta requirement. This is not statistical significance, not resident-watch latency, not old-upstream comparison, and not complete current-main historical coverage. Earlier diagnostic and shared-host results are not acceptance samples for this cohort, and Stage35 stays rejected. One boundary I keep explicit: absolute seconds from this cohort must not be compared against Stage32, Stage35 or the rejected attempt, because per-arm host speed on this machine has varied about threefold across sessions and that factor is still unexplained; every gate here is a ratio or a within-cohort comparison precisely because such a factor largely cancels there.

Nothing under /tmp/enola-local-surface-guarded/ or any other root-owned tree was modified; I read only, and I ran no build, test, benchmark or measurement load. No worker_done on this dispatch: I remain retained, idle and source-only. Standing offer continues unchanged for any future cohort, including the conditions that pass.

messages.subject: Re: Stage36 review checkpoint
messages.body:
Checkpoint: the review is finished and already sent as msg_6bad427439cc, so nothing remains and no time is outstanding. Your path clarification in msg_445112387445 matched what I had read; every path listed there was covered, plus SCENARIO_LIMIT.md, summarize-timing.py and the gate modules, the two history receipts, per-arm provenance and config, and the coordination evidence linked from timing-window.json.

No blocker. No gate failure. engineering_accepted true is supported and every figure reproduces to the last digit: body -8.786548 percent against the -5 percent bar, all six paired changes negative with worst -7.316225, disjoint body ranges, no non-primary median regression, max RSS change +0.7789 percent, mean scenario median ratio 0.9765965050876149, aggregate -0.417083 s. Host, power, pressure, pins, counterbalancing and correctness all check out. Seven items are recorded in the full reply as context or archive hygiene, none of them decision-changing: pair 6 contention with the direction favoring the candidate (jackknife still -8.41 percent without it), the run-id naming artifact, the body End payload -16 bytes accounted to the byte, nondeterministic summary_scans and derived_indexes, run-to-run state_final_bytes, the stale pins.json purpose string, and the cache-based full-suite receipt.

One correction worth having before publication so it is not quoted wrongly: the at-most-4.9 ms wall-minus-monotonic figure from Stage35 was a per-sample measure, not a series-level one. Recomputed with this cohort's formula Stage35 gives 2143 to 2330 ms, matching this cohort's 2149 to 2274 ms, and the gap is instrumentation between the clock reads. The fine-grained detector here is the per-pressure-sample offset, spread 3.91 ms across 3567 samples: no suspension.

Noted that you are on a shared-host ten-cycle watch soak. I am running nothing and will start nothing; I remain idle and source-only, and I will not touch the unrelated long-running processes. Available for any follow-up read you want during or after the soak.
